author: DonaldMyTrump
body:
Hello Staff members of avicus, specifically Para since he will threaten anyone who responds to this other than himself or someone who directly represents himself with demotion. I would like a DISCUSSION on my ban rather than a robotic response spouting out the same old crap.

Refering to Para's statement of
"Racism is a violation of the rules. It's been clarified to you. It's also not permitted to target a certain race, sex, or have any form of discrimination." make your appeal go quicker."I would like to cite myself saying

"If the real reason for the ban is racism (which I believe it is) then I would like to point out that several staff members including Mango_ and Administrafer told me racism was allowed, other staff members also allowed me to be racist without warnings/kicks so it would be reasonable for me to assume it was legal. I would also like to point out that racism which used to be specifically indicated as something that wasn't allowed in 18+ was removed from the list of things not allowed, therefore most players would be likely to assume it is now allowed. In fact when the initial infraction for racism was given out Administrafer appealed me saying that racism is allowed in 18+ as long as I didn't target specific users repeatably. While 18+ does follow 3 guidelines I broke none of these guidelines as I neither spammed, trolled or bullied. While trolling and spamming seem rather straight up I have heard racism related to bullying. I would like to correct this as bullying is defined as use superior strength or influence to intimidate (someone), typically to force him or her to do what one wants. Therefore unless I am being accused of hoping the words I said to reach a party which I was addressing (I didn't address the insults to anyone) to force a reaction from that person and some satisfaction from me this cannot be considered bullying. Even If I did say these things and they reached a party who I meant to describe with it (even though I didn't) this would qualify as gossip unless there is evidence I wanted it to reach the person/party and took steps to ensure it did." This statement clearly defines what I did and why it's not illegal, please review it carefully and respond accordingly.

 Another thing Para brought up that I would like to point out is "As well as being a former staff member, you should be aware of what may be questionable or not to say. That, for which, you have had "troll-like" behavior in which we don't welcome." I am aware that the behavior is questionable, I'm also aware that it is not illegal on avicus 18+ TS  something you have proven yourself unaware of.
I also would like to point out that at no point did I insult the staff team in my appeal as Para stated "Also, insulting the staff won't make your appeal go quicker." 

Now, can you please read the rules and take note that I violated none of them? Thank you.

title: Appeal for TS

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello.

I am unsure of why the administrators have told you that racism is not against the rules. 
Racism is most certainly against the rules on Avicus; it is a form of bullying, which is not allowed on the 18+ channel. You should understand this.

As for your insulting the staff, your last statement:
"29 views and 4 days later... Hi guys! It's zac, since no Sr staff member has made a decision, provided evidence or corrected me on my interpretation of the rules can I get appealed now?"
Please do not leave comments like these on appeals. Don't automatically assume that we haven't made a decision. Posting these types of things will ultimately lower your chances of a senior moderator checking your appeal.

Also, your previous appeal was denied. There was no point in creating this one.

This appeal is denied.

Regards,
MidnightBeats
Senior Moderator
